run_MOF_adsorption_energy_analysis: run the script to parse MOF adsorption energy data and identify promising pristine and defective MOFs for CO2 capture
generate_MOF_parity_plot: generate a scatter plot comparing CO2 vs H2O adsorption energies for pristine and defective MOF structures
parse_adsorption_energy_filenames: parse raw adsorption energy filenames to extract MOF name, defect concentration, defect index, and adsorbate configuration
filter_promising_MOFs: filter MOF structures where CO2 adsorption energy is below -0.5 eV and more favorable than H2O adsorption
compute_lowest_adsorption_energies: compute the lowest adsorption energy per MOF across multiple configurations for CO2, H2O, and co-adsorption cases
